+ Begin with the digit in the greatest place value.
« Compare ones : 2 ones = 2 ones
> * Compare tenths : 9 tenths = 9 tenths
« Compare hundredths : 4 hundredths < 5 hundredths
8 5 S0, 2.948 < 2.957
SG compare 0.26 and 0.206

a ee
¢ Begin with the digit in the greatest place value.
= * ¢ Compare ones : 0 ones = 0 ones
* Compare tenths : 2 tenths = 2 tenths
* Compare hundredths : 6 hundredths > 0 hundredths
So, 0.26 > 0.206
